No entry in `ASSUMPTIONS.md`, “Modeling Assumptions,” resolves the remaining setup gaps.
rawReview.critique: The encounter is RAW-legal and internally coherent but is not fully executable without explicit Table Decisions. Record the Skeleton damage convention (fixed 6 or 1d6 + 3) and either their ammunition quantities or an explicit interpretation that “necessary ammunition” cannot be depleted during this battle; the latter is especially material because the scenario says ammunition matters. Define whether arena edges are impassable boundaries or exits and whether they provide cover, since flight can end combat. Each adventurer’s pre-initiative record must also include worn armor, donned shield, held/readied items, and any Heroic Inspiration—particularly if Human is selected—because inventory ownership and “all feature uses unspent” do not determine those states. These are setup decisions, not tactical choices.
